suggestions.original_text: Backend engineer with 5 years of experience building distributed systems. Comfortable across the stack with a focus on Python, payments infrastructure, and developer tooling.
suggestions.suggested_text: Backend engineer with 5 years of Python experience building distributed systems for payments and billing. Strong PostgreSQL fundamentals, hands-on with event-driven architectures, and comfortable owning production services end-to-end including on-call.
suggestions.rationale: Mirrors the JD's required-skills list (Python, PostgreSQL, event-driven, on-call) without inflating experience.

suggestions.original_text: - Worked on the payments team building backend services.
suggestions.suggested_text: - Designed and shipped Python services on the billing team, including idempotent invoice retries that recovered ~$2.4M/yr in transient failures.
suggestions.rationale: JD calls out retries, idempotency, and recovery explicitly. Re-wording the bullet to anchor on those exact words is a high-value alignment.

suggestions.original_text: - Improved the speed of a slow batch job.
suggestions.suggested_text: - Cut p95 latency on the nightly invoicing batch from 88m to 14m by parallelizing PostgreSQL reads.
suggestions.rationale: Concrete numbers, mentions PostgreSQL (JD tech stack), and ties to invoicing.

suggestions.suggested_text: - Carried primary on-call for the billing service; reduced page volume ~30% by replacing raw error-rate alerts with SLO-based alerting in Datadog.
suggestions.rationale: JD asks for on-call participation and lists Datadog in the tech stack.

suggestions.original_text: - Built REST endpoints in Python for the public API.
suggestions.suggested_text: - Built and operated the rate-limited public API in Python, including Kafka-backed audit logging and an event-driven webhook fan-out.
suggestions.rationale: Adds Kafka and event-driven (both in the JD), and surfaces production ownership.

suggestions.original_text: - Contributed bug fixes to the company's open-source SDK.
suggestions.rationale: Internship bullet that doesn't move the needle for this JD; trims to keep the resume tight.

suggestions.original_text: Python, Go, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Kubernetes, AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda), Terraform, Docker, Linux, Git.
suggestions.suggested_text: Python, Go, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Temporal, Kubernetes, AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, SQS), Terraform, Docker, Datadog, Linux, Git.
suggestions.rationale: Adds Temporal and Datadog, both in the JD tech stack and reasonable given the existing experience.

suggestions.suggested_text: Particular interest in dunning workflows and revenue-recovery patterns.
suggestions.rationale: JD specifically mentions dunning. This adds a one-liner of intent that helps the resume signal fit without inventing experience.

suggestions.original_text: A small key-value store I wrote in Go for fun. Implements a write-ahead log, basic compaction, and an HTTP API.
suggestions.suggested_text: A small key-value store I wrote in Go to learn storage internals. Implements a write-ahead log with crash recovery, size-tiered compaction, and an HTTP API.
suggestions.rationale: Adds the words 'crash recovery' which map to the JD's reliability emphasis, without inventing scope.
